name: Pančićev vrh
subtitle: Kopaonik piste (curated way order)

provenance.method: All OSM ways named Панчићев врх in the extract were inspected against the 25 m DEM. Zero-net circuits and out-of-tolerance alternates were excluded; the remaining four ways were pinned in an order whose endpoint joins measure 0 m and whose DEM profile descends monotonically.
exclusionNotes: Ways 1122810583-1122810586, 915223219 and 1003621284 are mapped as closed circuits (start equals end; DEM shows zero net drop), so they cannot represent a descent as-is.
Way 44225657 (762 m) is an older alternate mapping of the same north branch; the 958974764 + 44225656 + 958974765 chain replaces it.
Ways 44225684 and 50893722 trace eastern alternates; their joins to the selected branch exceed the 30 m tolerance.
Way 44225629 carries no piste:type tag and climbs (+236 m) in the mapped direction.
knownGaps: Single-branch selection: the fork at ~1840 m offers two lines; the western branch is included, the older eastern duplicate is not.
Race-line fidelity is unchecked against official course data (no verified official facts exist for Kopaonik).

chainStrategy: curated ordered way list; joins verified by exact endpoint overlap, oriented by DEM elevation
